title: Tailoring electronic and optoelectronic properties of 2D-SiC via defects and doping: a first-principles study toward efficient white light-emitting diodes
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,29335-29366
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04586J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Md. Mahfuzul Haque, Sajid Muhaimin Choudhury
DFT analysis reveals that defect and dopant engineered 2D-SiC retains a direct band gap, enabling efficient light emission. A proposed LED design achieves tunable white light via RGB mixing, highlighting 2D-SiC's promise for advanced optoelectronics.
